# CrossCover 1.6.1-crosscover.1

Based on CrossInk 1.6.1. This release supports Xteink X3 and X4.

## Added

- Integrated the CrossInk 1.6.1 searchable Library, metadata sorting, reader drawer, navigation, status-bar customization, and reading-statistics improvements.

## Changed

- Moved Hardcover to the reader's bookmark-icon Location tab, immediately after Sync Progress on X3/X4.
- Reduced LibGen download progress redraws to once per second between completion updates.
- Removed automatic GitHub CI checks.

## Fixed

- Hardcover authentication uses the minimal network boot to leave more memory available for TLS.
- Hardcover progress updates handle editions without a page count correctly.
- Hardcover credentials and book links use recoverable atomic writes.
- LibGen downloads preserve existing books and publish the new file only after a complete transfer.
- LibGen search results appear before cover thumbnails load, and responses stay within device limits.
- The deployed LibGen relay normalizes cover JPEGs that the device decoder could not read, including the tested Shoe Dog covers.
- The battery status bar is hidden during LibGen downloads to avoid flickering percentage changes.
- Fixed conflicting Windows compile actions and CRLF handling in SdFat build patches.

## Installation

Use `firmware-x3-x4-v1.6.1-crosscover.1.bin` only on a supported, non-USB-locked Xteink X3 or X4. Back up important SD-card files before updating.

The X3/X4 firmware was built and checked on the device by the maintainer. Other device builds are not hardware-validated CrossCover releases.
